title: Family mourns father of two killed by Toronto cops
article: The province's special investigations unit has identified John Menga, a 29-year-old father of two, as the victim of a fatal shooting involving two Toronto police officers who are now under investigation.
Menga's family and friends gathered yesterday at his home to mourn and question the circumstances of the shooting.
"My brother should still be alive," said Menga's brother Resul.
"My brother shouldn't have been shot like that," he said.

According to previously published eyewitness accounts, Menga, who was driving a stolen Jeep with a passenger aboard, was shot Friday night when he tried to run down two officers who ordered him to stop.
"I think he panicked and he was scared," said Menga wife, Rosa, 27.
"He was a good father. He loved his kids."
